title: Crispy Chilli Turkey Noodles
description: Caramelized ground turkey in a honey-sriracha glaze over udon noodles with fresh vegetables.
steps: Fry the turkey mince until golden and crispy, breaking it up as you go.
Add ginger and garlic, then stir in honey, soy sauce and sriracha.
Cook the noodles, toss with lime juice, then top with the crispy turkey, carrots and spring onions.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food crispy chilli turkey noodles

notes: Turkey mince is leaner than beef, and the honey helps the sauce properly caramelize onto the meat.
